review_type: Independent pre-export source, foreground and layout review
reviewed_conditions: Hovratten follows district-court appeal and may sometimes change its decision.
Supreme Court only considers leave-granted cases, with leave granted rarely; precedents are generally followed.
Human-rights complaint condition and exhaustion of ALL Finnish remedies retained.
Civil loser OFTEN pays the other costs; SOMETIMES each pays their own; fear may discourage claims.
Criminal defendant often pays IF found guilty; if innocent, MAY APPLY for cost compensation, without a guaranteed refund.

findings.resolution: Producer supplied separate person/coin icons without the interparty arrow, labelled respective costs. Corrected actual frames15/16 personally viewed at640x360 each in /tmp/c06-overklagande-refined-costs.jpg.
